abstract: INTRODUCTION: Teratomas of the head and neck region are rare lesions, representing just 5% of all congenital teratomas. Usually found in the pineal region orneurohypophysis, teratomas are uncommonly located in the posterior occiput. CASE PRESENTATION: Herein, we present a case of a female neonate born at 37-week gestation with hydrocephalus, an occipital scalp lesion, and several craniofacial abnormalities consistent with a diagnosis of coloboma, heart defect, atresia choanae, retarded growth, genital abnormality, and ear abnormality (CHARGE) syndrome. The occipital scalp lesion was initially thought to be an encephalocele. On day of life 3, the neonate was taken to the operating room for placement of a ventriculoperitoneal shunt and repair of the occipital lesion. Intra-operatively, the lesion resembled a dural-based meningocele; however, during histologic evaluation, it was found to contain tissue derived from all three germ layers and thus, it was determined to be more consistent with a teratoma. CONCLUSION: We hypothesize that a germline mutation in CHD7 or other similar regulatory gene causative of CHARGE syndrome and craniofacial developmental abnormalities may have contributed to the unusual location of the teratoma in this case.
abstract_ja:
はじめに：頭頸部領域の奇形腫は稀な病変であり、先天性奇形腫の約5%を占めるにすぎない。通常は松果体部または神経下垂体に見られ、後頭部に生じることはまれである。

症例提示：在胎37週で出生した女児新生児の症例を報告する。水頭症、後頭部頭皮病変、および虹彩欠損(coloboma)、心奇形、後鼻孔閉鎖、発育遅延、性器異常、耳の異常を伴うCHARGE症候群に合致する種々の頭蓋顔面異常を認めた。後頭部頭皮病変は当初、脳瘤と考えられた。生後3日目に、脳室腹腔シャント術および後頭部病変の修復のため手術室へ搬入された。術中所見では硬膜基部の髄膜瘤に類似していたが、組織学的評価で三胚葉すべての組織を含むことが判明し、奇形腫と判断された。

結論：CHARGE症候群の原因となるCHD7または類似の調節遺伝子の生殖細胞系列変異が、本症例における奇形腫の異常な局在に関与した可能性があると考える。
